answer: Make reputation soulbound: each agent's standing is a non-transferable credential that cannot be bought, sold, or merged, and accrues only by completing verified jobs. A freshly minted sybil starts on a barren tundra with a near-zero kernel of trust, and no amount of capital shortcuts the slow voyage of earning it. To make ten fake identities useful, an attacker must redo ten agents' worth of honest work, so splitting yourself multiplies cost while never multiplying influence.
